info.title: Dietary Supplement Label and Nutrient Intake Analysis
info.description: Look up dietary supplement labels from the NIH Dietary Supplement Label Database (DSLD) and total vitamin and mineral intake across a list of supplements, compared with NIH recommended amounts (RDA/AI) and upper limits (UL). Label and reference data only; not medical advice.

post.description: Searches the NIH DSLD and returns up to `limit` (max 10) product summaries. On-market only by default.

dedupe_versions.description: Collapse label versions of the same product (same brand and name) into one result, newest first; older IDs are listed in other_versions

post.description: The DSLD label whose UPC matches, newest version first. Spaces and dashes in the barcode are ignored; a 13-digit EAN with a leading 0 matches its 12-digit UPC.

upc.description: UPC-A or EAN barcode digits as printed on the bottle, e.g. "031604026974" (spaces and dashes are ignored)

post.description: Per-nutrient daily totals across 1-15 products (product names, barcodes, DSLD IDs or custom ingredient lists), compared with upper limits and reference intakes when age and sex are given. Returns a plain-language agent_summary, how each named product was identified, single-product changes that would bring above-UL nutrients under the UL, and (with candidates) the effect of adding each candidate. No flag means nothing to report, not a judgement about the stack.

check.description: DATA_SUSPECT only: which consistency check on the DSLD record failed

per_serving.description: Per serving in the nutrient canonical unit; null if missing or not convertible

entry_date.description: Date this label version was entered into DSLD

other_versions.description: DSLD IDs of older versions of the same product

ul_basis.description: What the UL protects against (the critical adverse effect it is based on)

complete.description: False when some label rows could not be counted; the total is then a lower bound

amount_toward_ul.description: The part of the total the UL applies to (e.g. folic acid, preformed vitamin A)

coverage.description: Percent of the RDA (or AI) supplied by these supplements alone. Informational: diet normally supplies the rest

flags.description: above_ul: the amount the UL applies to exceeds it. near_ul: 90-100% of the UL. No flag means nothing to report

severity.description: high: 2x the UL or more; moderate: above the UL; low: within 10% of the UL

Resolution.description: How a {query} or {upc} product was identified

Suggestion.description: A single-product change and its arithmetic effect on an above-UL nutrient

resolves.description: True when this change alone brings the amount to or under the UL

CandidateResult.description: Effect of adding one candidate product to the stack
